gap: Hysteresis holds by being a one-way ratchet with no re-evaluation: a 4 s transient at boot (classroom Wi-Fi, a Chrome update, 30 Chromebooks loading at once) is decided on frames 1.5-4.0 s after the first render, can leap 3 rungs to potato in one change, and downSteps===0 blocks every promotion for the rest of the session - measured: 120 ms frames for 4 s then 3 minutes of flawless 60 Hz still ends at potato, and no A-group claim tests a transient. Secondary: Lighting.js clamps shadows to 2048 x2 so 'high' and 'medium' build IDENTICAL shadow rigs, making the module doc's and B8's '3072 x3 cascades' justification fiction; and quality:tier has zero subscribers so drawDistance/grassDensity/particleBudget/shadowCascades are emitted and dropped.
note: Heuristic default inverted (medium unless the renderer string names a discrete GPU); heuristic cap is now the policy ceiling; stand-down switch re-read every frame and applies the player's tier to the renderer; first decision window cut to 30/45 with wall-clock caps, and a down-step leaps ceil(log2(over-budget)) rungs; Intel Iris/Xe/Arc and AMD APU families added. 39/39 claims pass (A17/B11/C9/D1/D2 new); critic probe 15/17.
